accounts_provider_account.name: accounts_provider_account
accounts_provider_account.where: "accounts"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."provider_account_id" IS NOT NULL

household_members_active_user.name: household_members_active_user
household_members_active_user.where: "household_members"."left_at" IS NULL AND "household_members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

audit_events_hash_version.name: audit_events_hash_version
audit_events_hash_version.value: ("audit_events"."hash_version" = 1 AND "audit_events"."leaf" IS NULL) OR ("audit_events"."hash_version" = 2 AND "audit_events"."leaf" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("audit_events"."leaf") = 32 AND "audit_events"."seq" IS NOT NULL)

transactions_transfer_expected.name: transactions_transfer_expected
transactions_transfer_expected.where: "transactions"."transfer_expected_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."transfer_group_id" IS NULL

rules_name.name: rules_name
rules_name.value: "rules"."name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("rules"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80
